representation: physical-plus-flag ket followed by an explicit partial trace
canonical_flag_rule: A_prime=A and B_prime=B on each nonzero branch
signed_witness_rule: change the sign only when i1=j1=i2=j2=0
reduction_rule: sum ket amplitudes times conjugate amplitudes explicitly over the physical B and flag B_prime indices
left_basis_map: combined AA_prime index is 4*A+A_prime; the logical subspace has A_prime=A
